Let today be X. Then day before yesterday = X-2 days. According to statement, X-2 = day after Monday = Tuesday. So X-2 = Tuesday. Therefore X = Thursday. Because Tuesday +2 = Thursday. So today is Thursday. Then tomorrow is Friday. So answer B.

Thus output just "B".
